* '''PC-E4''' ([[A Step Backward & Higher Ground (V)]]): retitled in errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 2 May 2014, effective immediately<ref name="forum-p879652">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 2 May 2014: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p879652 p879652] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: the first title (and the physical card under the slip) changed from Found Someone You Have to A Step Backward, so that both halves of the combo card are unique. '''What changed:''' the title “Found Someone You Have & •Higher Ground” became “•A Step Backward & •Higher Ground”; the game text did not change. The rules team made the change “to pre-empt any issues with card uniqueness and combo cards”.
